adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: A term newborn with severe refractory respiratory failure and biallelic SFTPB loss has SP-B deficiency; the primary defect is failure of normal surfactant organization and stable alveolar phospholipid-film function.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: CFTR, ciliary dynein, alpha-1 antitrypsin and pulmonary vascular NO responses affect different compartments and do not explain SFTPB-associated neonatal alveolar disease.
